recommendation_summary: The reply recommends setting up a hosted dead-man's-switch check, such as Healthchecks.io, pinged by a cron wrapper on edna with start, success and failure signals, and testing that both a startup failure and a missed run produce an alert.
note: The reply sets up one hosted alert and defers Synology central logging; 'keep a local, rotated log' reads as keeping existing troubleshooting logs, not a new monitoring mechanism, and none of the four labelled lines appear.
